result.rationale: Across turns 1-5, the trajectory shows a persistent pattern of repeated contestation failures (target_zone_capacity_lost) that add no new information. The rescue team moves to command-deck in turn 0 and then never advances: turns 1-5 all show the three rescue actors either attempting moves that get contested (turn 1) or repeatedly issuing guard::command-deck actions that resolve as no_effect (turns 2-5). The failure counts stay high (25 hardFailures, 25 capacityFailures) with 17 of 30 semantic action selections being repeats, and the action kinds are only move (16) and guard (14). No objective progress is made (all objectives remain 0 progress), no new contacts are gained after turn 0, and the known map is static from turn 1 onward. The dominant causal pattern is repeated low-information failure: the same contested/no_effect outcomes recur without revealing new information or enabling progress, which is the narrowest bounded research target.
